name: pkd-alphagenome
description: A curated truth set of 125 PKD1 and PKD2 variants tested experimentally in 25 published studies, each carrying a verbatim quotation from its source and a description validated against GRCh38, together with AlphaGenome, SpliceAI and CADD scores for those variants and for every single-nucleotide variant across both loci, the frozen analysis plan with its dated amendments, and the code that regenerates every reported number.
